name: SyntheMol
one_liner: Monte Carlo Tree Search over 132,000 molecular building blocks and 13 validated chemical reactions, guided by an antibacterial activity predictor and wet-lab assays.

loop.proposes: Tree expansion combines REAL-space molecular building blocks under validated chemical reaction templates.
loop.judged_by: Reaction compatibility rules verify synthetic tractability at every node, while a Chemprop GNN/MLP oracle scores antibacterial activity against Acinetobacter baumannii.
loop.steers: MCTS upper-confidence rollouts focus combinatorial search on high-scoring, Tanimoto-diverse reaction pathways before wet-lab synthesis and MIC testing.

headline_result: Searched a combinatorial space of 30 billion synthesizable molecules to discover 6 structurally novel compounds with potent wet-lab antibacterial activity against A. baumannii.
caveat: Search space is restricted to 1-2 step combinatorial reactions from the Enamine REAL building-block catalog.
beyond_harness_note: Monte Carlo Tree Search over formal reaction templates calls a GNN property predictor and validates top candidates in wet-lab bacterial growth assays.
generative_model: Chemprop GNN value oracle + reaction-template MCTS
algorithmic_authority: SMARTS chemical reaction validator, MCTS, and wet-lab MIC assay

sources.title: Generative AI for designing and validating easily synthesizable and structurally novel antibiotics (Nature Machine Intelligence, 2024)

verification.notes: Checked against Swanson et al., Nature Machine Intelligence 6, 2024.
